'''Liuxian''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

Liuxian is the keeper of '''Liuxian Teahouse''', who calls [[Yuanwu]] "Master".

Liuxian notes that:

* [[Chenpi]] likes Pu'er tea
* [[Pianyu]] prefers white tea
* [[Yuanwu]] drinks fresh Trine Tea, "a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself"

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Liuxuan:''' Thanks to the patronage from my lovely neighbors, Liuxian Teahouse is still driving after all these years.
:'''Liuxuan:''' When a regular customer enters the teahouse and sit down with their teacup ready, I would know exactly what tea they want to have.
:'''Liuxuan:''' Chenpi likes to have Pu'er, Pianyu prefers white tea, and as for Master Yuanwu...
:'''Liuxuan:''' I'd roast some fresh Trine Tea myself every day, wrap it in oil paper, and then bring it over to his boxing gym.
:'''Liuxuan:''' It's a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself. I usually pick the tea leaves and roast them here at the teahouse.
:'''Liuxuan:''' Sometimes I feel that relationships between people are like tea leaves. The more they are encompassed in warmth, the more fragrant they become.
{{Dialogue End}}
